title: Canonical intrinsic compact-support realization comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow Z,p:Z\to Y)$ a compactification of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $E_W$ be the canonical equivalence from sheaves of modules over the fixed scalar ring $A$ to sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A_W$, extending scalar action to locally constant sections [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-weil-extension-by-zero], and use the same notation for its termwise derived equivalence [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. In the fixed-scalar presentation use $F^c_{\mathrm{fix}}=Rp_*j_!$; in the intrinsic constant-ring presentation use $F^c_{\mathrm{int}}=Rp_*^{\mathrm{int}}j_!^{\mathrm{int}}$, with the specified extension by zero and derived direct image [def-weil-extension-by-zero] [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Define the canonical realization comparison $I^c:E_X F^c_{\mathrm{int}}\cong F^c_{\mathrm{fix}}E_Y$ (here functor products are in left-to-right order) by the following composite: reassociate; identify $E_Xj_!^{\mathrm{int}}$ with $j_!E_Z$ by cancellation of the unit of the specified coefficient equivalence; then apply the specified comparison $E_ZRp_*^{\mathrm{int}}\cong Rp_*E_Y$, fixed on constant sections and K-injective representatives; finally reassociate. Thus the comparison is the composite of these canonical isomorphisms, not an arbitrary isomorphism of its endpoints.
